title: A Bondy-type theorem for rainbow pancyclicity in graph systems
summary: We establish a Hamiltonian-to-pancyclic analogue of Bondy's theorem for graph systems under an aggregate degree condition. Let $\G=(G_1,\ldots,G_n)$ be a graph system on a common $n$-vertex set $V$, and write $δ(v)=\min_{i\in[n]}d_{G_i}(v)$. If $\G$ contains a rainbow Hamilton cycle and \[ \sum_{v\in V}δ(v)\ge \left\lceil\frac{n^2}{2}\right\rceil-1, \] then $\G$ is rainbow pancyclic, unless $n$ is even and every member is the same balanced complete bipartite graph.
